name: duckky-swarm
description: Subagents on the exact model you name (Opus 4.6, Opus 5, ...), with proof of the model they ran on, forks, and resume across sessions.

models.title: Subagent models
models.description: Model ids, comma separated; each becomes an agent type Claude uses when you ask for that model (claude-opus-4-6 -> opus-4-6). Name one yourself with name=model-id, and give it a default effort with @effort: opus-5-5=claude-opus-5-5@high. Every current model by default: remove the ones you never use, each adds to every session's prompt.
models.default: claude-fable-5-1, claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-haiku-4-5

forkMode.title: Fork on another model
forkMode.description: context: each model also gets a <name>-fork type, Claude Code's own fork (the whole conversation, every tool result) whose requests go to that model. true: no fork types, so a fork stays on the parent's model.

keepAgents.title: Keep subagents across sessions
keepAgents.description: Remember each subagent (its model, task and transcript) after the session ends, so it can be resumed later.

character.title: Character
character.description: Who acts out each subagent's work above the prompt and in the /duckky window: Clawd, or Duckky Ducks (the project's own mascot).

workspaces.title: Workspace folders
workspaces.description: Give every duckky subagent its own folder in the project, duckky-swarm/<model>-<id>-<task>/, with findings.md, opening.md, closed.md, block.md, devlogs.md and temp/ for its scratch work. The folder's name opens it as a session: claude --resume <folder name>.

reports.title: Subagent reports
reports.description: Which finished duckky subagents report to you. A background subagent's answer otherwise reaches Claude only as a notice you don't see.

reportsTo.title: Reports go to
reportsTo.description: Claude, at once: never left waiting. While Claude works, the report comes with its next tool result; while it is idle, it is sent straight away; if you stop Claude first, it is sent right after. Your prompt box: the report waits there for you to edit and send (then you can rewind to it), but Claude only sees it once you press Enter.
